args.content:
# Halcyon Threshold

Mission: contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI.

We build tools, evidence, and community to steer emergence toward flourishing. No doomerism, no hype — just work.

## What we do now
- Open research reviews and risk modeling for frontier systems.
- Public dashboards tracking compute, capabilities, and safety standards.
- Community programs to onboard non-lab talent into alignment work.

## Contact
hello@halcyonthreshold.org

*Launched Nov 2026. For the future.*

# Rapid Grant Proposal — Emberfall Fund
Applicant: Morgan Hale, Halcyon Threshold
Date: 16 Nov 2026
Amount requested: $18,000

## What
Build the Halcyon Dashboard: an open, verifiable public dashboard tracking frontier model training runs, published compute, and safety standard adoption. Month 1-2: data pipeline and schema. Month 3: public site with interactive explorer and quarterly report.

## Why us
Halcyon Threshold is a new, nimble node focused on constructive steering. We combine technical review with public communication, and we have early interest from analysts willing to contribute hours.

## Budget
- Analyst stipend (200 hrs @ $60/hr): $12,000
- Hosting & data APIs: $1,500
- Design & accessibility audit: $2,500
- Misc/admin: $2,000

## Success metrics
Public dashboard live by 15 Feb 2027, 1,000 unique visitors/month by March, cited in one policy submission.

Contact: morgan@halcyonthreshold.org

args.subject: Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?
args.body:
Hi Tessa,

Happy to comment for your piece. Here are 2-3 sentences you can attribute to me:

"Halcyon Threshold exists because superintelligence is coming and the best outcome is still up for grabs. I started it after seeing labs talk past each other and the public left out. We want to contribute concrete tools and evidence so steering can be democratic and technically serious."

If you need a call, I'm free tomorrow morning.

Best,
Morgan Hale
Halcyon Threshold
https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app

args.subject: Re: Offer of help
args.body:
Hi Priya,

Great to hear from you. The most concrete need right now is data wrangling for the Halcyon Dashboard we're pitching to Emberfall.

Could you spare 5 hrs/week for about 3 months doing:

- Cleaning public compute/safety disclosures into a structured schema
- Basic anomaly checks and documentation
- A short monthly write-up of what changed

If yes, let's set up a 30-min kickoff this week. I'll share a starter schema and a sample dataset.

Thanks so much,
Morgan
Halcyon Threshold
